To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of sampling techniques in combination with statistical and intelligent techniques is an effective approach to improve the accuracy of credit risk assessment and default probability estimation.

(i) the proposed models are effective in predicting credit default risk; (ii) the use of sampling techniques in combination with machine learning techniques improves the performance of the models in comparison with the use of these techniques without sampling; and (iii) ROS and SMOTE are effective sampling techniques for the credit risk management.
(1) the combination of intelligent techniques with sampling strategies is more accurate than the use of the intelligent techniques alone, and (2) SMOTE performs better than ROS.
